gloss: one bite, one sip, in a word

definitions.gloss: one bite, one sip, one mouthful
definitions.explanation: A single bite of food or a single sip of a drink.
Used to express summarizing something concisely, often in the pattern 一口に言う (to put it in a word).

examples.japanese: {一口|ひとくち}⟦もらって→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧？
⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一口|ひとくち}⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧みた。
examples.english: I tried one bite of the cake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一口|ひとくち}⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧、⟦ほっとした→ほっとする：07652_hottosuru⟧。
examples.english: I took a sip of cold tea and felt relieved.

examples.japanese: {一口|ひとくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I can't explain it in a word.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一口|ひとくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さまざまだ。
examples.english: Even though we say 'ramen' as one word, there are many different types.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一口|ひとくち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}できない→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧ほど⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧。
examples.english: Japanese culture is too deep to explain in just a few words.

notes:
{一口|ひとくち} has two main uses: as a literal quantity (one bite/sip) and as an abstract expression meaning "in a word" or "briefly."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一口|ひとくち}⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to take one bite
- {一口|ひとくち}⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to take one sip
- {一口|ひとくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to put it in a word
- {一口|ひとくち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧: can't explain briefly

RELATED COUNTERS:
- {二口|ふたくち}: two bites/sips
- {一口|ひとくち}⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧: bite-sized
